title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Still gonna get a really good player. Always a reason to panic a few weeks before draft
I just got a call from a "rival exec" who said they're taking Bart
He said Mize's medicals are a mess or something
Medical has always been a question with him, just never really knew what was going on with them because he never had surgery
Whatever, I have no clue how this stuff works
I definitely have a horse in the race now, though. We put a lot of eggs in the Mize basket this week
I gotta do this big ass story on him, because everything I've got from Al and David Chadd is Mize
I’ll give you my favorite scouting catch phrase/motto, applies to literally all phases of this job “Semper Gumby”
I feel like a dumbass now, because we should've split the trip up
And tackled Bart, too. We flew in and out of ATL
Eh, we won’t know who we are really taking until June 4. A couple weeks is an eternity
That part is a bummer though lol
The Free Press has not followed Semper Gumby
